assets.prompt: Use case: historical-scene. Asset type: production background texture for a desktop WWII card game's battlefield, landscape 16:9. Show a worn 1940s dark walnut military planning desk viewed perfectly straight down, horizontal wide wooden planks, deep grain, small scratches, uneven patina, warm restrained diffuse light, dark vignette at the far corners. Keep the whole central playing area (x 17%-83%, y 8%-94%) empty and flat wood, medium brown and readable, without clutter. High detail, understated military atmosphere.
